verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has only feature-level marketing claims: transcription in 100+ languages, multi-language mode, speaker identification and real-time transcripts. Nothing documents which ASR models are used, any accuracy figures (e.g. word error rate), or known limits such as accents, audio quality or language-specific caveats. That is the 'AI-powered' style of claim the story contrasts against, so it does not deliver the transparency asked for.
